posts.text:
Clarence Thomas came from nothing, endured crushing racism, and rose to the Supreme Court.

If he were a liberal, he would be venerated by every institution in America.

Instead, because he dared to think for himself, the Left has responded with silence and hate.

That’s why I wrote Going Further.

Order now at https://t.co/2ANWgLIPqD.
